Nested block grammar of the C&C Generals Zero Hour INI dialect. Derived from GeneralsMD/Code + Core + engine/gui/wnd sources: top_level_blocks = theTypeTable in Core/GameEngine/Source/Common/INI/INI.cpp (matched case-sensitively via strcmp). nested[parent] = field names whose FieldParse proc calls ini->initFromINI/initFromINIMulti/initFromINIMultiProc (block closed by its own 'End', matched case-insensitively). Sources: ThingTemplate.cpp (Object/ObjectReskin tables: ArmorSet, WeaponSet, Prerequisites, UnitSpecificSounds/FX, Behavior/Body/Draw/ClientUpdate via Module::friend_newModuleData or MAKE_STANDARD_MODULE_DATA buildFieldParse, AddModule/ReplaceModule/InheritableModule/OverrideableByLikeKind which re-enter the Object field table so their children equal Object's; RemoveModule is a ONE-LINE field, not a block); W3DModelDraw.cpp (ConditionState/DefaultConditionState/TransitionState; AliasConditionState is ONE-LINE despite sharing parseConditionState); AIUpdate.cpp (Turret/AltTurret); RadiusDecalTemplate::parseRadiusDecalTemplate used by module fields DeliveryDecal (DeliverPayloadAIUpdate, NeutronMissileUpdate), AttackAreaDecal/TargetingReticleDecal (SpectreGunshipUpdate), GridDecalTemplate (DynamicShroudClearingRangeUpdate), OCL DeliverPayload/Attack DeliveryDecal, and InGameUI *RadiusCursor fields; FXList.cpp, ObjectCreationList.cpp nuggets; AI.cpp (SideInfo>SkillSet1-5, SkirmishBuildList>Structure); Eva.cpp (SideSounds); CampaignManager.cpp (Mission); ChallengeGenerals.cpp (GeneralPersona0-11); ControlBarScheme.cpp (ImagePart, AnimatingPart>ImagePart); ShellMenuScheme.cpp (ImagePart, LinePart); engine/gui/wnd GameWindowTransitions.cppm (Window). top_level_single_line lists top-level types whose parser consumes no 'End' (BenchProfile, LODPreset, ReallyLowMHz read their values from the same line; MapData's parser is an empty stub). ControlBarResizer's parser body is commented out in source, but shipped ControlBarResizer.ini uses normal block form (fields AltPosition/AltSize + END), so it is treated as a normal block here. legacy_unregistered_blocks are block types present in shipped data but NOT in theTypeTable (the engine never loads them): 'ButtonSet' (Data/INI/Default/ButtonSets.ini) and 'WebpageURL' (Data/INI/Webpages.ini); both are simple End-terminated blocks with no nested openers. Context-by-parent-key ambiguities: 'ParticleSystem' is a top-level block and also an FXList child (both blocks, no conflict); 'Draw' under Object vs ObjectReskin (both blocks); 'ImagePart' under ControlBarScheme and AnimatingPart; 'Science'/'Object' are one-line fields inside Prerequisites and SkillSetN but top-level block names - a parser must use nested[parent] only, never top_level_blocks, when inside a block. Behavior children (Turret, AltTurret, *Decal*) are only openers for the module types that declare them; no module type uses those names as one-line fields, so parent-key context is unambiguous. Key-value openers with arguments exist: 'Behavior = Type Tag', 'ReplaceModule Tag', 'ConditionState = FLAGS', 'TransitionState = A B', 'Mission Name', 'WeaponSet'/'ArmorSet' (no args). Tokenizer: legacy readLine treats ';' as comment start anywhere (no quoting), maps control chars (tabs) to spaces, seps are ' 
	='; '//' is NOT a comment in the legacy parser. Not covered: ScriptEngine's separate Scripts.ini-style reader.
